blocks.text: The Philippines in the past week has showcased the best of its culture and hospitality for its international guests as it played host to the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Leaders Summit and related events with global leaders, which conclude today. Ahead of the summit, Filipinos saw the transformation of the metropolis into a pleasant, orderly, and livable environment with clean streets, smoothly moving traffic, and well-maintained public spaces, including sidewalks where people can actually walk on.
